export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (slug suzuki-motorcycle-india-private-limited): "2026-02-28 | SUZUKI MOTORCYCLE INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED | RANCON MOTOR BIKES LIMITED, Engine Production Parts For MotorCycleManufacturing:SPRING,CENTER STAND NO.2,42242-34J00-000- | GARI HARSARU ICD INGHR6, India | Chittagong, Bangladesh | 73209090 | 1144328" — i.e. dated 2026-02-28, origin Gari Harsaru ICD (India), destination Chittagong, Bangladesh, HS 73209090, B/L 1144328. Page header: "Total Shipments 682877", "Trading Partners 141", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-28". Rows actually seen on the free view: 5 shipment rows (all dated 2026-02-28, buyer Rancon Motor Bikes Ltd, Bangladesh, HS 73209090, B/Ls 1144328 / 1143998 / 1142904 / 1142851). Source counter 682877 vs 5 rows visible.
domestic_evidence: Company's own site (suzukimotorcycle.co.in/about-us) documents an operating manufacturing plant and domestic sales network: "We have installed our manufacturing plant in Gurugram (Haryana). Total land area of the facility at Gurugram is 37 acres", "Number of employees 4700+", "Main Products Motorcycles and scooters", plus a dealer/service-centre network and sales & marketing office in Gurugram. This is a plant + domestic distribution footprint, not a shipment record; no GST turnover figure, GeM/CPPP tender or contract line was retrievable (web_search tool returned connection errors on all queries), so GST turnover band = null.
note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records (not just website claims): recurring India→Bangladesh parts shipments to Rancon Motor Bikes Ltd via Gari Harsaru ICD, latest seen 2026-02-28, B/L 1144328, HS 73209090. Domestic side: manufacturing plant and dealer network are documented, but no GST turnover band or public-procurement contract could be verified in this session — turnover/export value fields left null rather than estimated. IMPORTANT HS DISCREPANCY: declared HS 848240 (ball bearings) does not match the observed shipment HS 73209090 (springs/iron articles) or the company's actual product line (motorcycles/scooters, HS 8711). Per project rule 3 this is NOT grounds for rejection — company stays in the base, actual HS should be corrected to 8711 (vehicles) / 73209090 (parts as shipped), verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Industry claim "Металлургия и горнодобыча" is also wrong — this is automotive two-wheeler manufacturing. Note on the batch: the name string bundles 7 entries, of which 6 are the same legal entity (Suzuki Motorcycle India Pvt Ltd) and one is a different company, INTEGRA OVERSEAS PVT LTD, for which no shipment evidence was checked in this session — it needs a separate verification pass. No CIN/PAN was public on the pages read; left null.
